subject: CloudEra GSI — availability handshake & proposed tech deep-dive
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <d.park@cloudera-gsi.com>, Samantha Lee <sam.lee@cloudera-gsi.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CloudEra GSI — availability handshake & proposed tech deep-dive

Hi Daniel / Samantha —

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — appreciate you walking us through the three pilot workloads and the marketplace timeline. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: tenant isolation + private catalog for managed customers.
- Priority: Marketplace listing + dedicated infra for predictable throughput (Q1 onboarding target).
- Success criteria: <10% token-cost delta vs baseline, <150ms median p95 for standard queries for 8k context.

Next step: we recommended a 60-minute technical deep-dive with our Solutions Architect + Marketplace onboarding owner to align on integration points, onboarding checklist, and expected timelines. Attached is a short demo agenda and a requirements checklist to help surface any gaps before the deep-dive.

Proposed 60-min slots (PST):
- Mon Nov 22 — 10:00–11:00
- Tue Nov 23 — 13:00–14:00
- Wed Nov 24 — 09:00–10:00

Please confirm which slot works best and let us know if you want to include any additional folks (SA, procurement, or network/security). We’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a Teams/Zoom link once you pick a time.

Attachments: [redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 210KB)], [cloudera_requirements_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 72KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: CloudEra GSI — availability handshake & proposed tech deep-dive

Jasmine — thanks for the summary and the attachments.

Tue Nov 23 13:00–14:00 PST works on our side. Please include our Solutions Architect, Aisha Kumar (aisha.kumar@cloudera-gsi.com) — she will drive the technical intake and network requirements. Procurement is targeting a kickoff the week of Dec 7, so aligning the integration checklist on this call would be ideal.

Quick note from our discovery: one customer workload (analytics search) will require longer contexts (12k) but is lower QPS; others are standard. We’ll surface dataset retention constraints on the call.
